item.title: The Modern Author: Arianna Huffington on Burnout, Focus, and Creative Energy
item.description: Arianna Huffington didn’t burn out because she was weak. She burned out because she was successful, driven, and running at full speed with no off switch. After collapsing from exhaustion in 2007, she didn’t just recover. She rebuilt her entire philosophy of work, creativity, and leadership. That journey led to Thrive, Thrive Global, and a career-long mission to end the burnout epidemic.
